FRIDAY.comment: Set apply_override=true for institutions blocking midday periods for Friday Jummah prayers

SATURDAY.comment: Set apply_override=true with day_active=false for Mon-Fri unis, or max_period=6 for half-day Saturdays

twilight_buffer.comment: Allows evening sessions to start at P11 (11-12 or 11-14) with a soft penalty so solver prefers P13-P18 first

venue_affinity.description: Declarative 3-Tier Departmental Venue Affinity & Hard Specialized Lab Sub-Pool Configuration. Tier 1A = Exact Module Preferred Venues; Tier 1B = Cohort Home Venues; Tier 1C = Department Prefix Pool; Tier 2 = General Category Overflow Pool.

Theory / Lecture Room.description: Soft home-turf preference: prioritize Tier 1 (Module / Cohort Home / Dept Prefix) venues before overflowing into the general category pool.

Computer / Digital Lab.description: Soft home-turf preference: prioritize Tier 1 (Module / Cohort Home / Dept Prefix) venues before overflowing into the general category pool.

Engineering / Science Lab.description: Hard departmental sub-pool lock: sessions may only use venues in their module or department prefix pool.
